Game Overview

Deko 2 is a monster title where embark on a thrilling 2D platform adventure with a charming monster as you navigate challenging levels. Master your double-jump to outmaneuver cunning enemies and perilous obstacles. Collect ice creams for boosts and aim for the pink flag in this exciting sequel that tests your skill and quick reflexes.
